checklist.item: Ambiguity resolved with a recorded decision
checklist.note: Selected 'analytics' with score 1.0. Rule: highest rubric score, then lexical id. Ranking: analytics=1.0, aliases=0.9, auto_expire_all=0.25. Non-breaking, testable, low-risk, in-codebase, and narrow scope score higher. Demo mode records this choice so the run can continue. A supervised run pauses until a person picks an interpretation.

checklist.item: Task plan executed for this brief
Shortener contract tokens present in the test suite
Security policy clear of blocking findings
Compliance controls: retention, purge, and referrer sanitizing

checklist.note: Approved by demo_policy after the pre-approval checkpoint. Supervised mode would wait for a person. Demo mode records the pre-approval checkpoint and then auto-approves so a CLI run can finish. This is not a human release sign-off.

production_gaps: SQLite and the in-memory rate limiter are process-local.
Create, stats, and delete are unauthenticated. A custom alias is a guessable capability.
The orchestrator runs in-process. It is not an isolated worker fleet.
Generated patches are applied only inside a run workspace. They are not merged to the main checkout.
Demo approval is recorded in the audit log. It is not a production change-management control.
Referrer retention is a fixed day window in one SQLite file, not a per-tenant policy.
